Reasonable restaurant for both Domestic and international foodies
Apr 2019 • Business
This restaurant is very famous for The Southern food, especially rice cake ( bánh xèo) . 
I took one of my Singapore clients there. He was satisfy with the restaurant service and food
Food quality: 

The food is good quality. The cake case is very crunchy and has strong turmeric flavor. 
Their “ che” is average quality, not typical taste. 
Salad tastes is really great, balance 

Cleanliness: 

The restaurant is quite clean and spacious. 
Service: 

Fast service, good staffs. 
The temperature should be lower, It was quite hot when I was there. 
Highly recommend for both Asian an western clients who want to try Saigon food.

reviews.review_text:
Sam Neu
Brooklyn, New York11 contributions
0
great vegetarian banh xeo
Jul 2018 • Couples
Crispy, not greasy pancake, plentiful filling, lots of herbs and greens to go with, and solid juice options. Easy menu to navigate for English-speakers (pictures, English descriptions, etc.). My partner is a vegetarian and was very happy here - flavorful mixed mushrooms and bean sprouts made the banh xeo very filling and satisfying. I loved the dipping sauce in particular. 

There are certainly cheaper options with more Vietnamese locals in HCMC for getting your banh xeo fill, but if you have a vegetarian in your group, this comfortable spot is a good option for meat-eaters and vegetarians to both enjoy.
